//: gcm config mau - copy sang config.json roi XOA key khong doi.
//help: Xem tat ca key + mac dinh + nguon dang dung:  gcm config
//edit: Sua nhanh:  gcm config set lang vi   |   gcm config unset lang
//note: Key khong co trong file se lay mac dinh built-in.
//api_key: Groq API key free tai https://console.groq.com/keys  - mac dinh: ""
//lang: ngon ngu mac dinh cua commit message  (vi | en)  - mac dinh: "en"
//model: model Groq dung de sinh message  - mac dinh: "openai/gpt-oss-120b"
//tui: true = mac dinh chon file kieu TUI (mui ten + space)  - mac dinh: false
//push: hanh vi push sau khi commit  (ask | always | never)  - mac dinh: "ask"
//coauthor: trailer 'Co-authored-by' khi push tu gcm ('off' de tat)  - mac dinh: "devduide <devduide@users.noreply.github.com>"
//system_prompt: override cach AI viet message (file system_prompt.md uu tien hon)  - mac dinh: ""
//last_repo: repo mo gan nhat trong GUI (gcm tu ghi, khong can sua tay)  - mac dinh: ""
